description: Where this person's YouSpot setup stands, for setting them up in this conversation when they ask to get set up or get started with YouSpot. Returns what YouSpot already knows about them (`known`, correctable with update_my_profile), the profile questions still open in priority order (`missing_profile_fields`, each saved with update_profile_fields), the best next accounts to connect with their payoff and link (`suggested_connections`; connecting happens in the browser), and whether a daily brief can be turned on with start_your_day (`can_start_your_day`).
name: get_onboarding
title: Get set up
